candidates.name: 内部query candidate bundle
candidates.proposal: 抽出真正返回getData settle的内部prepare，独立candidate view/request/token，输出response/data/drill/map/error；不改活动状态/Store/events/snapshot/loading；保留认证网络链和可观察副作用。

candidates.name: 共享renderer hooks
candidates.proposal: 参数化hostId/instance/chart/scale/theme/interaction sink/scope；复用attempt与当前hooks；prepare前不dispose活动scope；stage禁活动action/default事件/replay；返回前异常安全消费平行lane。

candidates.name: SFC内双host资源槽
candidates.proposal: 唯一string id的可测量sibling stage host；SFC内部独立slot/queue/timer/observer/cleanup owner；不再mount完整Chart，不新增相同viewId query监听；具体DOM交换及重绑待Design。

candidates.name: prepare/commit/abort内部接点
candidates.proposal: prepare返回candidate/abort仅释放candidate；重验后commit tree/data/error/drill/map/curView/details/origin/lastRequest/host/dirty/snapshot/event；发布次序、失败/事件再入/回滚由下一Design冻结；禁止先写活动树再calcData。
